title: the run verb's own tooth asks a tester on its own box
intention: The run-verb tooth of test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface asks the tester's run verb of a bus on the same box as its fixtures, so it reads the verdicts of the fixtures it names whatever CAIRN_BUS_HOME the session carries.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_the_run_verb_answers_with_the_testers_verdict red "green_proof.py: no record came back: {'refused': \"no proof file at '/home/akien/cairn/cairn/devices/tester/proofs/fixtures/green_proof.py'\"}". reach('tester') is a RemoteBus to akiendelllinux.local:7419 (CAIRN_BUS_HOME), so the Dell's tester was asked about akienasus's disk. Same shape as 42ddfe3b7256.
traces_to: Law 3 - a tooth measures the thing it names, not the route to another box; Law 8 - a proof must be runnable on the box that builds it.
how: _ask_run's ask moves into a child of the proof (--ask-run <path>) under home_env(scratch_dir('testing-67b7-'), PYTHONPATH=repo); the child's reach('tester') lazy-inits a throwaway-table bus; the parent shuts it down after. Teeth per clause added under a PROVES key for this ticket.

clauses.claim: with the session's CAIRN_BUS_HOME naming another box's bus, the run-verb tooth reads green for green_proof, red for red_proof, and a refusal for the missing path
no scratch bus process outlives the proof

decisions.text: D1: in the proof, _ask_run(proof) runs this file with --ask-run under a scratch HOME (short prefix, AF_UNIX path limit), parses the last stdout line, and in finally shuts down RemoteBus(<home>/.cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/0); clause teeth: (1) CAIRN_BUS_HOME=far-box.invalid:7419 around the run-verb tooth, (2) after an ask the scratch bus dir exists and remote._answers is None. Template: _ask_run_on_this_box in test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped.py.

measured.how: bin/cairn test cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface.py on akienasus, session CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419
